scope: Actual final pre-compatibility production Next routes: import-ordering, regional textures, V102 and V103 editors, real generated fronts and isolated browser archives. All original data assertions retained; one keyboard reachability check added. The four recipes use fresh browser contexts, deterministic generated worlds and disclosed storage/clipboard or native-file-read fixtures.
sourceIdentityAuthority: Build mdrv and1293 app byte bookends, exact recipe copies; not Git HEAD alone or a claim about a later compatibility build.
interfaceChanges: Real native dialog close/open clicks surround map, theater, territory and end-turn interactions.
The visible theater opener receives automatic focus after a planet change, verified before any scripted keypress; Enter then Tab reaches the picker.

Native aria-expanded state and actual dialog close/show readiness avoid clicking behind pending modal effects. No force-click, DOM state/scroll mutation, state reducer substitution or longer timeout was introduced.
The route returns through the actual Quitter le conseil button.

assertionPreservation.independentDiffReview: Read-only pr131_metadata_review confirmed modal navigation and original save/geometry assertions; its focus coverage concern was fixed before the final full replay.
